candidate_passages.text: The ICS 2026 paper measures a switched CXL memory pool and reports local DRAM and pooled-memory CPU access latencies of 214 ns and 658 ns in its setup. It also evaluates GPU transfers, contention, and scaling across CXL devices, while noting that pools lack hardware-managed cache-line interleaving across devices.
candidate_passages.candidate_claim: A 2026 real-platform CXL pool study shows that latency, cross-device balance, contention, and transfer direction must be explicit dimensions in evaluating pooled memory for GPU communication.
